source_refs.note: Book p. 52-55: 2.10 heading (no own text; the section starts with 2.10.1); our overview of the subsections

blocks.text: Is section mein hum ek naya aur bohat kaam ka sawal uthate hain. Pichle section (2.9) mein humne dekha tha ke function kahan barhta hai aur kahan ghatta hai. Ab hum poochte hain: function apni sab se oonchi value kahan pohanchta hai aur sab se neechi value kahan? Sochiye aap pahar par chal rahe hain: raaste mein kai chottiyan aur kai wadiyan aati hain, aur un mein se ek chotti sab se oonchi hoti hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kitab 2.10 ke heading ke neeche khud koi text nahin likhti; section seedha 2.10.1 se shuru hota hai. Yeh mukhtasar taaruf (overview) hamari taraf se hai.
Function ki sab se oonchi aur sab se neechi values ko extreme values ya extrema kehte hain: maximum yani sab se bari value, minimum yani sab se chhoti value.
Do qisam parhenge: global (absolute) extrema, jo poore interval mein sab se bari ya sab se chhoti value hai; aur local (relative) extrema, jo sirf us point ke aas paas (qareebi ilaqe) mein sab se bari ya chhoti value hai. Misaal: kisi shehar ki sab se oonchi building global maximum jaisi hai, jab ke har mohalle ki sab se oonchi building us mohalle ka local maximum hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
Teaching note
blocks.text: Yeh kyun zaroori hai? Sab se zyada munafa (profit), sab se kam kharcha (cost), sab se taaqatwar signal, sab se kam waqt: yeh sab extreme values hi hain. Is unit ka section 2.14 inhi cheezon ko asal zindagi ke sawalon par lagata hai. Is liye yahan ki buniyaad mazboot honi chahiye.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(f(x) = x^{2}\) ki sab se chhoti value kya hai, aur sab se bari? (Jawab: sab se chhoti value 0 hai, \(x = 0\) par, kyun ke square kabhi negative nahin hota. Sab se bari value koi nahin: \(x\) jitna bara lein, \(x^{2}\) us se bhi bara milta hai. Yeh baat 2.10.2 mein kitab khud dikhati hai.)

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Is section mein "maximum" aur "maxima" dono lafz aayenge: maxima maximum ki jama (plural) hai, aur minima minimum ki. Kitab kabhi "relative" aur kabhi "local" likhti hai; dono ka matlab ek hi hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Extrema = function ki maximum aur minimum values.
2. Global (absolute): poore interval ke har point se muqabla. Local (relative): sirf qareebi points se muqabla.
3. Interval ke andar extrema critical points par hote hain; closed interval mein end points bhi zaroor check karne hote hain.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Point aur value mein farq na karna: maximum value \(f(c)\) hai, aur woh \(x = c\) par aati hai. Jawab mein dono likhiye.
2. Har local maximum ko function ki sab se bari value samajh lena: ek local maximum kisi doosri jagah ke local minimum se bhi neecha ho sakta hai.
